function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
Cream is a versatile, neutral shade that can work well in many settings—whether you’re dressing for a casual outing, a business meeting, or a special event. Here are a few quick pointers to help you decide if it’s the right choice for you:

| Factor | How Cream Works | Tips |
|--------|-----------------|------|
| **Skin tone** | Cream tends to look best on people with warm or neutral undertones. It can brighten cool‑toned skin, but may sometimes wash out very fair or very dark complexions. | If you’re unsure, try holding a cream fabric near your face in natural light. Does it make your skin glow or look dull? |
| **Occasion** | Cream is a safe, understated color for daytime events, office wear, or relaxed gatherings. For evening or formal events, pair it with richer hues or metallic accents to add depth. | Pair cream with navy, charcoal, or deep burgundy for a polished look. |
| **Season** | Cream is a classic spring/summer staple, but it can also be layered in fall/winter with darker neutrals or jewel tones. | In cooler months, add a cream coat or scarf over darker layers for contrast. |
| **Style** | Cream can be a base for layering or a statement piece on its own. It pairs nicely with pastels, earth tones, and even bright colors. | Use cream as a backdrop for patterned or textured fabrics to keep the outfit interesting. |
| **Personal preference** | If you love the look of cream and feel confident in it, that’s the most important factor. | Try a few different shades of cream (off‑white, ivory, beige) to see which feels most natural. |

**Quick test:** If you have a cream‑colored item (shirt, dress, jacket), hold it up to your face in natural light. Does it complement your complexion or make you feel washed out? If it looks flattering, go for it! If not, consider a slightly warmer or cooler neutral instead.

Feel free to let me know more about the occasion, your skin tone, or any style preferences you have, and I can give more tailored advice—or even help you find a specific cream‑colored item that fits your needs.
